title: Replay-with-drops [E10] has no core pin — spec code map claims one that does not exist
evidence: spec-3-3-contention.md line 71: "- [x] `core/qos_test.odin` -- E7/E9/E22 pins + replay-with-drops pin (the contracts landed here, the QoS contract home; `flow_test.odin` stayed unmodified)". Worktree core/qos_test.odin 3.3 section (test_qos_serialize_budgets :431, test_qos_lone_packet_full_capacity :443, test_qos_no_starvation_under_continuous_express :471, test_qos_drop_ladder_e9 :502, test_qos_pool_exhaustion_e22 :584, test_qos_drop_ladder_e9_double_shed :657) contains NO record_run/clone_log replay. The only replay test in the file is the pre-3.3 test_qos_replay_byte_identical (:323): "live_hashes := record_run(&live, 30, cat)" — emphasis+lane edits only, era 0 (run_init :230 "state.era = 0"), no flow_seed_demand, so no Packet_Dropped events ever enter its hash stream.
detail: P1 gap on a P0 path: the new Packet_Dropped payload bytes (serialize.odin:254 tag-conditional w_u16/w_u8) are never replayed live-vs-replay in core, contradicting the spec's code map and its I/O row "Replay | run with drops, re-sim from the action log | identical drop events + queue state — byte-identical hashes (E10)". Only the out-of-chunk harness demo gate (chunks 2-5) exercises it.
recommended_fix: Add a core pin: drive an E9/E22 drop scenario (lane_pipe_setup + queue_packet + seeded demand) through record_run twice — live and replay from a cloned action log — and assert byte-identical per-tick hashes; update spec line 71.

title: E9 shed-target identity unpinned — all 21 combos assert dropped CLASS/count, never which packet (NEWEST tail)
evidence: core/qos_test.odin:524 "queue_packet(&s, class_of[lane], res, rt, true, 0, rt)" (parked ids never captured) and :561 "testing.expectf(t, count_drops(&s, class_of[shed_lane], .Queue_Overflow) == 1," — the shed assertion is class-based only. test_qos_drop_ladder_e9_double_shed (:657) pins two DISTINCT BE sheds via count_drops == 2, which catches a duplicated splice index but not the FIFO end: an implementation shedding the OLDEST (head) instead of NEWEST (tail) packet passes every pin. Only E22 Case A pins a shed id (:607 "testing.expectf(t, !in_flight(&s, be_id), "E22 A: the BE resident must be gone")").
detail: P2 gap: the E9 contract "shed that lane's NEWEST packet (Queue_Overflow event), admit the arrival" — the NEWEST (tail) target is never asserted by packet id; a wrong-end shed (FIFO head) is invisible to all 21 combo pins and the double-shed pin.
recommended_fix: Capture queue_packet return ids in test_qos_drop_ladder_e9; assert the specific newest parked id in the shed lane is gone (and the arrival's id when it self-sheds), not just the dropped class.

title: Tag-conditional serialization has no byte-level pin — pre-3.3 event bytes verified only indirectly
evidence: core/serialize.odin:254 "if e.tag == EVENT_TAG_PACKET_DROPPED {" ... "w_u16(&w, e.class)" "w_u8(&w, e.reason)". No core test reads state_dump or asserts event-stream bytes: grep of core/*_test.odin shows no state_dump usage, and the writer-only event stream means log_read round-trips cannot cover it. A mutation writing the payload for OLD tags (breaking the "pre-3.3 event streams stay byte-identical" claim) would pass all 84 core tests; only the out-of-chunk light-demo T1 goldens would catch it.
detail: P3 gap: the append-only payload mechanism is 3 lines and the golden T1s (chunks 2-5) backstop it, but the claimed golden-stability property has no in-chunk regression pin.
recommended_fix: Pin the canonical event bytes: for a run emitting only Packet_Arrived (tag 1), assert state_dump of the tick's events equals the pre-3.3 shape (tick 8B + tag 1B, no payload); optionally assert a tag-4 event writes exactly 11 bytes.

title: E9 queue-full boundary at exactly lane_queue_packets-1 (5/6) untested — only empty (0/6) and exact-bound (6/6) pinned
evidence: core/qos_test.odin:522 "for k in 0..<bound {" :524 "queue_packet(&s, class_of[lane], res, rt, true, 0, rt)" — the ladder test always parks the queue at exactly `bound` (6); the non-combo arrival case (:547 "an arrival into an empty lane just joins") covers 0/6 only. The 5/6 case — the lane just below the bound, arrival must join with no drop — is never exercised; a `> bound` off-by-one in the admission check would survive every pin.
detail: P3 gap: the interesting boundary (>= bound fires, bound-1 joins) is half-pinned; the just-below-bound join path is the missing half of the boundary transition.
recommended_fix: Add one case to test_qos_drop_ladder_e9: park bound-1 packets in the arrival's lane, assert the arrival joins and count_drops == 0.

title: E22 pool guard never exercised on the director spawn path (flow_step 1b) — E22 pins drive legacy demand only
evidence: core/qos_test.odin:604 "flow_seed_demand(&s.flow, 1, res, rt, u16(email_idx))           // the arrival (S at spawn)" (same at :625 and :648 — all three E22 cases spawn via the 1a legacy path). The director path call site core/flow.odin:493 "flow_try_spawn(state, cat, spec.class, src, sink_ids[didx], tick)" is never run at pool exhaustion; test_director_* raise the cap instead (core/demand_test.odin:201 "cat.balance.pool_max_packets = 100000").
detail: P3 gap: both call sites share flow_try_spawn, so the risk is low, but the director path's spawn-at-cap behavior (drop event ordering vs weighted picks) is unpinned in core.
recommended_fix: Optional: one director-driven run (era 3, small pool_max_packets) asserting Pool_Exhaustion drops appear and replay stays byte-identical; otherwise document the 1a-only coverage in the spec.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 ≈100% at PR level: E7 (serialize_budgets + lone-packet keystone + no-starvation), E9 all 21 combos + double-shed, E22 A/B/C (all reachable states — arrivals are always Standard at spawn under the default_lane==1 canon), balance-key fail-fast (4 rows), light-demo keystone — all pinned and green (84/84). P1 ≈85%: replay-with-drops [E10] has no core pin (spec code-map claim false; harness-only). Overall ≈86%: tag-conditional bytes, bound-1, newest-identity, director-path gaps.
recommended_fix: To reach PASS: add the core replay-with-drops pin (findings 1) + the byte-level tag-conditional pin (finding 3); optional bound-1 and shed-id identity pins close the remaining P2/P3 gaps.
